This '''city''' was a major [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] maintained a residence at the government complex there. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] visited with the body of the [[Death Watch bomber/Legends|Death Watch bomber]] who destroyed the [[Peace Park/Legends|Peace Park]].

==Behind the scenes==
This unnamed city first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]], entitled "[[The Mandalore Plot]]."
